resources.string: One sentence creates the landscape around you.
For example: a lakeside at dawn, pine forest and thin mist, snow mountains in the distance…
%1$d / %2$d · describe the place, time and mood
Static 360° panorama · library is stored on this device only
Refine the previous result (keeps its composition)
A high mountain lake at dawn, surrounded by pine forest, thin mist over the water, snow-capped peaks in the distance, soft sunrise light.
A quiet beach at dusk, golden sunset over the sea, long sandy shore, gentle waves, sky fading from orange to violet.
A mountain valley at night, the Milky Way across a clear starry sky, dark ridgelines on the horizon, faint moonlight.
You can look at your library meanwhile and come back for the result.
Static panorama, best enjoyed by turning your head in place. The environment only changes after you enter.
Download complete. It now opens offline. A copy is in Pictures/SkyboxSpatial.
Stored on this device · works offline
Keep the places you love here
Nothing saved yet. Generate an environment, then tap the save icon.
The panorama file stored on this device will be deleted. It can no longer be opened offline.
Loading the panorama. You enter when it is ready; the current environment stays until then.
The system declined to open the environment. Your result is kept; try again.
Turn your head to look around. Use the console to turn the scene or leave.
Your description is kept. Edit it and generate again; that starts a new task.
The task is still on the server. Reconnect and check the same task; nothing is generated twice.
The panorama was generated but could not be downloaded. Only the download is retried.
The image was not written completely, so nothing was added to the library. Check free space and try again.
The generation service did not accept the request. Your description is kept.
The request was sent but no answer came back. Check whether a task exists before generating again, so you are not charged twice.
No matching task was found on the server.
Generation runs on the Skybox AI service with your own key. Paste it in settings; it stays on this device.
The API key was rejected (HTTP %1$d). Check it in settings.
Too many pending tasks on this account. Wait for them to finish.
Create a key at skybox.blockadelabs.com/api, copy it in the browser, then paste it here. It is stored only on this device and sent only to the Skybox API.
Model 3 styles generate 8K panoramas and support refining a previous result.
Enter a valid key to load styles.
